content: The God of Destruction Beerus, Frieza, and now — A new threat closing in on Earth, stands in the way of Goku and his allies. October 2026 Broadcasting and streaming begins! The anime Dragon Ball Super, original work, story, and character design by Akira Toriyama, is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus! #dragonball #dragonballsuper ◾️Anime “Dragon Ball Super: Beerus” | SUPER Launch Trailer https://youtu.be/OOmRInABehI ◾️Anime “Dragon Ball Super: Beerus” | SUPER GEKITOU Trailer https://youtu.be/-NekKfJN614 ◾️INTRODUCTION The globally beloved manga DRAGON BALL by Akira Toriyama continues to captivate fans through a wide range of media—from TV animation, movies, games, and merchandising—standing as a top-ranked title with extraordinary worldwide popularity. Now, in 2026, the anime Dragon Ball Super, original work, story, and character design by Akira Toriyama, is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus! This ENHANCED edition introduces a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, as well as a reconstructed narrative. With cutting-edge visual expression, the series delivers even more immersive battle scenes and a more faithful representation of the original manga—bringing an ENHANCED edition to life like never before. Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus’s overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku. Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe. chineseContent: 破坏神比鲁斯、弗利萨，还有现在——一个新的威胁正在逼近地球，挡住了悟空和他的盟友的道路。 2026 年 10 月 广播和流媒体开始！鸟山明原创作品、故事和角色设计的动画《龙珠超》将作为《龙珠超：比鲁斯》重新开始！ #dragonball #dragonballsuper ◾️动漫《龙珠超：比鲁斯》| SUPER发布预告片 https://youtu.be/OOmRInABehI ◾️动漫《龙珠超：比鲁斯》| SUPER GEKITOU 预告片 https://youtu.be/-NekKfJN614 ◾️简介 鸟山明创作的全球深受喜爱的漫画《龙珠》继续通过电视动画、电影、游戏和商品等多种媒体吸引粉丝，成为在全球范围内人气极高的顶级作品。现在，2026 年，由鸟山明原创作品、故事和角色设计的动画《龙珠超》将重新开始，名为《龙珠超：比鲁斯》！这个增强版引入了大量新添加和重画的剪辑，以及重构的叙事。凭借尖端的视觉表现力，该系列提供了更加身临其境的战斗场景和对原版漫画的更忠实的再现——以前所未有的方式将增强版带入生活。与魔人布欧的激战已经过去数年，地球终于恢复了短暂的和平。与此同时，破坏神比鲁斯从漫长的沉睡中醒来。即使是凯和至尊凯，意识到比鲁斯拥有毁灭整个行星的压倒性力量，也怀着极大的恐惧看着他的觉醒……与此同时，比鲁斯听到了赛亚人击败弗利萨的传闻——并突然出现在悟空面前。地球被宇宙最强生物比鲁斯盯上，陷入严重危险之中。一场天崩地裂的故事就此开始
